items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: I've been on a tune too, I have a third of them. Three of us. Jimmy Dupree, Ray McNamara.

ctx.x: Well I thought you recorded one of McNamara's tunes is the reason I asked.

Oh yeah, I made it, Nobody Knows Blues. Nobody knows, nobody knows. I've been on a tune too, I have a third of them. Three of us. Jimmy Dupree, Ray McNamara. Well did Jimmy Dupree write words or music or what? Oh he had a million tunes.
I bought a half interest in many tunes just to get it off my back.
